summary_en: Group sales target ¥50B+ and operating margin 4%+ by FY3/28 (revised down from 5% due to material cost inflation). Equity ratio 40%+ (3 consecutive years achieved). Payout ratio 30%+ target. Business portfolio restructured into three segments: Promotional Solutions, Content, and Environment. Capital efficiency improvement through execution and enhanced IR activity.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Measures toward Realization of Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 22 June 2026, Kyoritsu Co., Ltd. announced a revision of its capital-efficiency and stock-price awareness roadmap. The company's current PBR remains 0.4–0.5x, persistently below 1.0x, which the board attributes to weak business growth and operating margins. The revised targets extend to FY3/28 and comprise: group sales ¥50B or higher; operating margin 4% or higher (reduced from the prior 5% target due to rising material costs tied to Middle East supply-chain pressures); equity ratio 40% or higher (achieved for three consecutive years); and dividend payout ratio 30% or higher. The company has strategically restructured its business portfolio into three segments—Promotional Solutions, Content, and Environment—to maximize synergies and accelerate convergence toward the ¥50B sales threshold. Management plans to strengthen capital efficiency through disciplined execution of the business roadmap and expanded investor-relations activity.
